newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't sells 96 percent of coffee in auction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't sells 96 percent of coffee in auction.

text.p: The Brazilian government sold 86,284 60-kg bags of coffee or 95.85 percent of its auction today of 90,018 bags of stocks, said an official from the Banco do Brasil which held the electronic auction.
Prices ranged between 95.05 and 115.40 reais ($91.40 and $110.96) a bag, the official said.
The next auction is scheduled to be held on January 8.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
